substantive_findings.description: N3 correctly avoided product discovery, but it edited the installed skill in the clean Windows environment, contaminating later test state.
substantive_findings.recommended_action: Add test-packet guardrails: maintenance negative-control tests must request no file edits, or must be run in a disposable copy. Consider a future scenario that checks skill-maintenance mode explains intended edits before mutating installed runtime.

substantive_findings.description: P3 exposed superpowers:brainstorming in a user-facing response. This can confuse platform-agnostic skill behavior.
